projects.name: Lake Mariner HPC hosting (Core42 lease)
projects.quote: A pivotal milestone in this expansion was achieved on December 23, 2024, when TeraWulf signed long-term data center lease agreements with Core42, securing 72.5 MW of hosting capacity at Lake Mariner for GPU cloud compute workloads.

projects.name: Lake Mariner facility expansion to 500 MW
projects.quote: Includes electrical capital expenditures required to expand the Lake Mariner facility to 500 MW.
